name: Pick up an object
description: Grasp and lift an annotated movable object. The skill selects an available grasp strategy internally, including an edge grasp for suitable flat objects.
requires: The object exists in the current scene and has a feasible grasp annotation.
Any door or drawer blocking access to the object is open.
A reachable grasp can be found at execution time.
achieves: The robot holds the specified object.

outcomes.success: The specified object is held after lifting.
outcomes.failure: No feasible grasp or approach is found, or the object slips from the gripper.

verifier.evidence: Pick checks the grasp after lifting; check_held detects later slip during carry.

connections.when: The picked object is the object to put inside the container.
The picked object is the object to put on the surface.
